description: Package a project directory and deploy it. Sends the whole directory, not just an entry point: a deploy containing one file builds successfully and then serves a page whose assets all 404. Returns a taskId to poll with `deployment_status`. A .env file is never uploaded, and neither are node_modules, build output, private keys or Python virtualenvs; the result names any .env files that were left out. The application's variables come from `set_env`, `set_env_from_file` or the `env` argument here, and the platform sets the database, storage, sign-in and email ones itself. The folder must be linked to an application (`create_application`) unless this server has a project key. When it succeeds, tell the user where it is live and on which account.

applicationId.description: Deploy to this application instead of the one the folder is linked to.

directory.description: Project directory. Defaults to the working directory of this server.

env.description: Variables to store with this deploy. Write-only; never readable back.

force.description: Rebuild even when the content is byte-for-byte identical to the last deploy.

name: deploy
title: Deploy the project
